bio.text: Chris Mann, a Democrat, is the Democratic candidate for Kansas Attorney General in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Republican incumbent Kris Kobach.
According to the Kansas News Service, he was a police officer in Lawrence before going to law school, and later worked as a prosecutor in Wyandotte County and for the Kansas Securities Commission.

According to his campaign website, he attended Washburn University School of Law, worked in the Wyandotte County District Attorney's Office, and served as board chair of Mothers Against Drunk Driving's national board until 2020.
His campaign website says he lives in Lawrence.

sources.title: Who's running for Kansas attorney general? A familiar showdown between Kobach and Mann
sources.publisher: The Lawrence Times / Kansas News Service
